title: SNAPSHOT — Optimera snapshots and full reload
summary: Explore of the SNAPSHOT handler inside the price Ingress container: Create*Snapshot commands compose DirectDeliverySupplier/ValidProduct snapshots from ingress storage and send them to the domain queue; Reload* commands (enqueued by the M3Cloud reload timers) write full Optimera datasets as CSV files for Functions BLOB-OPTIMERA to import. Arrows explain responsibilities, never execution order or observed events.

Runbook/design: Features__IngressWithoutSnapshotCreation; admin recreate-all-snapshots for M3Cloud validproduct|directdeliverysupplier; SnapshotFullRebuildJobs in price-ingress DB; ASB empty/DLQ checks. Not deployment proof.

Historical 2021 overview: ADF nightly CSV dump → blob trigger → Function → SQL; Web API via APIM/Okta; names web-870-*/func-870-*/sql; ASB messages n/a. Design intent / historical ops — not proof of current topology.

uncertainties: dsp-price copy has no .git; evidence identified by per-file sha256 (Team Lead ruled HEAD check unnecessary).
Admin recreate-all-snapshots for M3Cloud validproduct/directdeliverysupplier is documented in Confluence 22774149 v3; the actual M3Cloud read path is still not traced in reviewed repo files.

Unresolved conflict: Confluence 22774388 v2 describes ADF nightly CSV ingress and ASB messages as n/a, while registration + PICO design (22773861 v67) and current handlers imply ASB queues/PICO — which path is live is unresolved; do not invent.

Full reload placed under SNAPSHOT: PriceSnapshotQueueHandler.cs dispatches the six Reload* subjects (case nameof(Reload*) at lines 74–119, sha256:73f40adb…); ReloadM3CloudDataTimerTriggers.cs only calls snapshotQueueClient.SendAsync (sha256:b51ebf13…), so timer-reload-m3cloud stays no-layer.
Re-cut from retired root layer:price.ingress-app (ADDENDA-011.1 per-handler roots); old layer id is ignored for dsp-arch-pos and not recycled. New split layers start auto-layout.
Responsibilities of sibling handlers in the same container are shown only as boundary queue/store nodes; no cross-root edges are drawn.
